comment: Extremely approachable, helpful and nice. She will go with you over any concept or homework problem you may not get, almost to the point of solving it for you! Very open and talkative: whenever I went to her office we chatted a lot and I was not starting it! However, it's always a pleasure to talk to her about anything. I wish she was my adviser!

She is so sweet, understanding and willing to help.  She really cares about her students and does everything she can to make physics less of a nightmare for us.  If you show that you are trying you will do well. Guaranteed.  Highly recommend her.

She is really enthusiastic about her job!She is extremely organized and everything is pretty clear!Covers the important concepts and know what she is talking about!Likes her job it is a pleasure to work with!!

She is very clear and will go over any problems you have as much as needed.  She doesn't do labs just for the sake of doing labs, but will have them as she deems appropriate.  Her class notes are all available online so you don't have to scramble to write down every detail that she says.  Excellent.
